description: Preview the repository's Shippp sync as a deterministic plan — NO writes. The repo root comes from the developer's own configuration (SHIPPP_REPO_ROOT env, or the server's working directory), never from tool input. Requires a committed shippp.target.json binding (created via shippp_bind_repository on the remote MCP). Returns the create/update/delete entries, hand-modified-file conflicts and any pending compiler/IR/adapter delta that shippp_sync_apply would need explicit approval for.
name: shippp_sync_plan
